title: Synthesis and optimization of biobased carbon adsorbent monoliths from chitosan-polybenzoxazine for efficient CO2 capture
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,6783-6793
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00110B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
José E. Mosquera, Liana Delevingne, Frédéric Delbecq, Elias Daouk, Audrey Drelich, Khashayar Saleh, Rémi Gautier, Mikel Leturia
Biobased porous carbon monoliths were synthesized from chitosan-polybenzoxazine. The precursor ratio and activation time were optimized to obtain high CO2 uptake and selectivity.
